text: Ammaa ɓen gomɗimɓe ma e goonga mo addanɗaaɓe on, ɓe golle golle-moƴƴe: immorde e juulugol, jakka, hoora, e jokkere enɗam, ekn, pellet, Alla Yoɓiray ɓe baraaji golle maɓɓe ɗen no timmiri; huunde ɗuytetaako e mun. Ndee yeewtere fii jokkuɓe "Almasiihu" on ado Nuleede Muhammadu (on mo jam e kisiyee woni e mun on); mo Almasiihu on tigiri wewlini fii mun. Alla Yiɗaa tooñooɓe ɓen, no jeyaa ko ɓuri mawnude e tooñe, kafidugol e Alla Toowuɗo On, fenna Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen.
